==English==
[[File:Salle de lecture Bibliothèque Mazarine depuis gallerie.jpg|thumb|250px|Bibliothèque Mazarine, Paris]]
[[File:Biblioteka Kraljevo .jpg|thumb|Biblioteka Kraljevo, Serbia]]

===Etymology===
{{root|en|ine-pro|*lewbʰ- (cut off)}}
From {{inh|en|enm|librarie}}, from {{der|en|xno|librarie}}, from {{der|en|fro|librairie}}, from {{der|en|la|librarium||bookcase, chest for books}}, from {{m|la|librarius||concerning books}}, from {{m|la|liber||the inner bark of trees; paper, parchment, book}}, probably derived from a {{der|en|ine-pro|-}} base {{m|ine-pro|*lewbʰ-|*leub(ʰ)-|to strip, to peel}}. Displaced native {{ncog|enm|bochous|bochous, bokhus|lit=book house}}, from {{ncog|ang|bōchūs}} (compare {{m|en|bookhouse}}).

{{cog|roa|-}} cognates often mean “bookshop” instead: {{cog|fr|librairie}}, {{cog|it|libreria}}, {{cog|es|librería}}, {{cog|ro|librărie}} and {{cog|pt|livraria}}. This is a relatively recent innovation (16th century in French), which ended up displacing the earlier sense.

===Pronunciation===
* {{IPA|en|/ˈlaɪ.bɹi/|a=UK}}
** {{IPA|en|/ˈlaɪ.bɹə.ɹi/|a=RP}}
* {{a|en|US}}
** {{IPA|en|/ˈlaɪˌbɹɛɹ.i/|/ˈlaɪ.bɹəɹ.i/|a=GA}}
*** {{audio|en|LL-Q1860 (eng)-Naomi Persephone Amethyst (NaomiAmethyst)-library.wav|a=GA}}
*** {{audio|en|en-us-library.ogg|a=US}}
** {{IPA|en|/ˈlaɪˌbɛɹ.i/|/ˈlaɪ.bəɹi/|a=non-standard,often stigmatized,see below}}
* {{rhymes|en|aɪbɹi|aɪbɹəɹi|aɪbɛɹi|s1=2|s2=3|s3=3}}

The non-RP UK pronunciation {{IPAchar|/ˈlaɪ.bɹi/}} (whence the [[eye dialect]] spelling {{m|en|libry}}) exhibits {{glossary|haplology}}. It generally isn't [[stigmatize]]d unlike the nonstandard American pronunciation, respelled as {{m|en|libary}}, which is often associated with [[illiteracy]], an association that may be exacerbated by the word's definition as a place to engage in literacy.

===Noun===
{{en-noun}}

# {{senseid|en|Q7075}}An [[institution]] which holds [[book]]s and/or other forms of [[media]] for use by the public or qualified people often lending them out, as well as providing various other services for its users.
#: {{syn|en|bookhouse|q1=nonstandard|bibliotheca|q2=obsolete|bibliotheque|q3=obsolete}}
#: {{cot|en|bookshop|bookstore}}
#: {{ux|en| She went to exchange her books at her local '''library'''.}}
#* {{quote-book|en|year=2012|author=w:Stephen King|title=11/22/63|page=133
|passage=When all else fails, give up and go to the '''library'''.}}
# {{lb|en|by extension}} Any institution that lends out its goods for use by the public or a community.
#: {{ux|en|You can check out a bandsaw from the tool '''library'''.}}
#* {{quote-book|en|year=2020|author=Noah Lenstra|title=Healthy Living at the Library: Programs for All Ages
|passage={{...}} bike '''library''' where, as of 2016, there had been 275 check-outs per bike per year between 2010 and 2016. According to the librarians, the bikes are constantly in use during periods of good weather (Vilelle 2017).}}
# A collection of [[book]]s or other forms of stored information.
#* {{RQ:en:New York Times|title=A 30,000-Volume Window on the World|author=w:Alberto Manguel|date=2008-05-15|url=https://www.nytimes.com/2008/05/15/garden/15library.html|passage=My '''library''' is not a single beast but a composite of many others, a fantastic animal made up of the several '''libraries''' built and then abandoned, over and over again, throughout my life. I can’t remember a time in which I didn’t have a '''library''' of some sort. The present one is a sort of multilayered autobiography, each book holding the moment in which I opened it for the first time.|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20251004155548/https://www.nytimes.com/2008/05/15/garden/15library.html|archivedate=4 October 2025}}
# A collection of information or reference materials not in book form.
#: {{ux|en|She has the most impressive record '''library''' I've ever seen.}}
#* {{quote-journal|en|journal=w:Architectural Digest|date=May 2026|volume=83|issue=4|title=Feeling Zen|author=Sam Cochran|page=100
|text=At his office in Copenhagen's Amager neighborhood, Thulstrup maintains a vast materials '''library''', arranging samples and mock-ups on tables as tactile mood boards.}}
# A room dedicated to storing books.
# {{senseid|en|software collection}} {{lb|en|programming}} A collection of software [[routine]]s that provide functionality to be incorporated into or used by a [[computer program]].
#: {{syn|en|library file}}
#: {{cot|en|framework}}
#* {{quote-book|en|year=2014|author=John Paul Mueller; Jeff Cogswell|title=C++ All-in-One For Dummies|publisher=John Wiley & Sons|isbn=9781118823781|page={{gbooks|N5otBAAAQBAJ|307}}
|passage=A static '''library''' is much  like any other '''library''' in that it contains a bunch of code for your application to use.}}
# {{lb|en|genetics}} A collection of DNA material from a single organism or relative to a single disease.
# {{lb|en|card games|Magic: The Gathering}} The [[deck]] or draw pile.
